2607.26588.title: Eco3S: Complex Socio-Economic System Simulation via Agent-Based Models
2607.26588.paper_summary: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has renewed interest in agent-based modeling (ABM). However, current LLM-based ABM research faces several key challenges: modeling evolving agent-environment interactions, enabling flexible counterfactual reasoning, and automating simulation workflows for scientific research. In this paper, we propose Eco3S, a socio-economic system simulation framework for economic research and policy analysis that addresses these challenges through three key mechanisms: (1) Co-evolving Environment Design, a bidirectional feedback loop where agents and the environment co-evolve, producing realistic emergent behaviors; (2) Structural Causal Simulation, a structural causal model (SCM)-inspired counterfactual mechanism that allows flexible interventions for diverse causal inference tasks; (3) Simulation-Analysis-Refinement Paradigm, a self-corrective mechanism that iteratively refines experimental designs based on prior simulation results. Experiments on diverse economic scenarios confirm \textit{Eco3S}'s effectiveness in replicating multiple established economic studies (canal decay, origins of governance, and information propagation) and phenomena across domains. Additional results further demonstrate its scalability and generalizability, highlighting the framework's potential for rigorous economic research and policy-making.
2607.26588.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）的快速發展重新引起了對基於代理的建模（ABM）的興趣。<lb/>然而，目前基於LLM的ABM研究面臨幾個主要挑戰：建模不斷演變的代理-環境互動、實現靈活的反事實推理，以及自動化科學研究的模擬工作流程。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了Eco3S，一個針對經濟研究和政策分析的社會經濟系統模擬框架，通過三個關鍵機制來應對這些挑戰：<lb/>(1) 共同演化環境設計，一個雙向反饋回路，代理和環境共同演化，產生現實的突現行為；<lb/>(2) 結構因果模擬，一種受結構因果模型（SCM）啟發的反事實機制，允許對多樣的因果推斷任務進行靈活的干預；<lb/>(3) 模擬-分析-精煉範式，一種自我修正機制，基於先前的模擬結果迭代精煉實驗設計。<lb/>對多樣經濟情境的實驗確認了\textit{Eco3S}在重現多個已建立的經濟研究（運河衰退、治理起源和信息傳播）及各領域現象方面的有效性。<lb/>附加結果進一步展示了其可擴展性和普遍性，突顯了該框架在嚴謹的經濟研究和政策制定中的潛力。
